convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for Digital_MACD indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Custom indicator with non-standard parameters makes auto-conversion impractical.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

other_exits: Opposite signal closes position when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions are enabled; signal logic inherently generates close signals alongside open signals

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum (LOT, FREEMARGIN, etc.) from TradeAlgorithms.mqh determines whether MM is fixed lots or deposit fraction. When MMMode=LOT, MM value is lot size; when MMMode=FREEMARGIN, MM is share of deposit.

custom_logic_notes: EA implements 4 selectable trading algorithms via AlgMode enum: (1) 'breakdown' - MACD histogram crosses zero; (2) 'MACDtwist' - MACD direction change (3-bar comparison: Value[0]>Value[1]>Value[2] reversal); (3) 'SIGNALtwist' - Signal line direction change (same 3-bar logic on buffer 1); (4) 'MACDdisposition' - MACD crosses signal line. Entry permissions are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen booleans. Exit permissions are gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose booleans. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates on current bar (intrabar); otherwise waits for new bar. Recount flag forces recalculation on data issues. Signal timing uses SeriesInfoInteger(SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE)+TimeShiftSec for trade timing passed to open functions.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of Digital_MACD custom indicator logic from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (digital filter smoothing). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions with built-in position checking, lot calculation, and order management - all must be reimplemented. The 4 AlgMode variants each use different buffer comparisons (buffer 0 vs zero, 3-bar reversal on buffer 0, 3-bar reversal on buffer 1, buffer 0 vs buffer 1 crossover). SignalBar parameter shifts all lookback indices. The Recount mechanism handles data availability failures. MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls lot sizing logic. SL/TP are in points (not pips), need to verify if 5-digit adjustment is needed for the specific symbol.
